en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Barqy, from Sa’ad Bin Sa’ad, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Rezaasws, said,
‘I asked himasws about the one in Ihraam, ‘Can he buy the slave girl, and sell?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Barqiy from Sa‘d ibn Sa‘d who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about a man who is in the state of Ihram; if he can buy and sell slave-girls. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, he can do so.”
